taxonomy.note: All ten unit themes and fluency targets map to the previously ingested Benchmark grade 2 scope and existing ELA taxonomy.

graduation.note: Every reusable student or parent surface resolves to an existing materials-studio recipe.

layer1_philosophy.methodology: A five-day Spanish readers-theater cycle for grade 2 that develops meaning first, models one fluency feature, assigns mixed-level roles, uses repeated guided rehearsal, and ends with performance plus self-reflection.
principles: Put repeated oral reading inside a meaningful performance context.
Connect fluency directly to comprehension rather than treating speed as the goal.
Assign roles across a range of guided-reading levels so heterogeneous groups can perform together.
Model one specific prosody or rate feature, then let learners rehearse it repeatedly.
Keep performance lightweight; costumes and a formal stage are optional.

evidence.claim: Each title uses a five-day instructional sequence
Repeated oral reading is the fluency engine

evidence.quote: La fluidez es una habilidad clave de lectura porque esté directamente relacionada con la comprensién.

layer1_philosophy.learningTheory: Explicit modeling, gradual release, repeated reading, oral collaboration, performance motivation, and reflection.
layer1_philosophy.assessmentApproach: Observe phrase grouping, intonation, rate, accuracy, expression, and meaning during rehearsal; end with self-reflection and supportive comments rather than a speed score.
layer1_philosophy.parentRole: Read the script aloud for meaning, model one fluency feature, assign accessible roles, guide two brief rehearsals, host a simple performance, and ask the child to reflect on meaning and voice.

knowledgeBankMatches.note: The source provides a concrete fluency and comprehension implementation of readers theater.

layer2_scope.coverage: Ten grade 2 Spanish scripts aligned to the ten Benchmark Taller del lector themes, with recurring comprehension, vocabulary, oral reading, prosody, collaboration, and performance.
layer2_scope.progression: Across the ten units, the fluency focus rotates through rate, pauses, intonation, volume, emphasis, phrasing, clauses, compound sentences, personification, mood, and dramatic expression.
layer2_scope.mappingNotes: The unit themes are already represented by the canonical Benchmark Taller del lector grade 2 curriculum.

layer3_structure.yearShape: Ten readers-theater experiences, one aligned to each three-week Benchmark reading unit.
layer3_structure.unitPattern: Day 1 read and discuss for meaning; Day 2 model and practice fluency; Day 3 analyze and assign roles with guided rehearsal; Day 4 rehearse and prepare; Day 5 perform, discuss, and self-reflect.
layer3_structure.weeklyTemplate: Five sessions of 20 to 25 minutes, with optional independent or group fluency practice between guided sessions.
layer3_structure.reviewRhythm: Every unit revisits accuracy, phrasing, intonation, rate, and expression while spotlighting one feature more explicitly.
layer3_structure.pacingNotes: The guide places the cycle in week three of each three-week unit, but a home can run the five short sessions whenever the related theme is active.
